d: Choir of both sexes Swiss. A fisherman in his boat on the stream. Thoughtful William, leaning on his spade; Edwige and Jemmy intent on various rustic works.
Melchthal from the hill, followed by other Swiss. Arnold and sayings meet him, and celebrate him.
Jemmy, Edwige, the Fisherman, Melchthal, Swiss chorus, three girlfriends and their spouses, and sayings.
Rodolfo with choir of soldiers and sayings.
Choir of hunters bringing the killed beasts, in the choir of shepherds inside.
Inhabitants of Uri on the side of the lake and sayings.

Grand square of Altdorf. At the bottom I saw the castle of Gessler. On one side there is a stage destined to the Governor. A few trees of lindens, apple trees, etc. a pole will be planted in the middle with a trophy of weapons, to which everyone will have to bow. Gessler, Rodolfo, officers, pages, guards, choir of soldiers and Swiss, and people.
Some soldiers drag on the proscenium William and his son, who watched among the crowd, and said.
The Gran Lago de' Quattro Cantoni. In the distance there are several rocks, above one of which is the house of William. Some rocks surround the lake. Edwige and choir of Swiss women.
Gualtiero, choir of Swiss armed and sayings.
